description: This file contains utility functions for processing and formatting error reports and test information related to Playwright tests, including generating prompts with error details, code snippets, and diffs.

methods.name: copyPrompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt message including test info, errors, code frames, and diffs for Playwright test failures.

methods.name: stripAnsiEscapes
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape sequences from a string to produce plain text.
